about: Prompt guide for sprite sheets made with Gemini (tools/gen-sprites.js). Each prompt is built from style, colour, background and layout, plus one sheet's subject. Items are drawn in grayscale with orange hairs so the game can recolour them per strain; the magenta background is removed by the cutter. 'cell' is the sprite size in the packed sheet; 'grid' is what the prompt asks for (the cutter finds the items wherever they are).
style: A sprite sheet for a cartoony 2D game, in the style of clean Flash-era vector game art: smooth bold shapes, soft cel shading in three or four tones, a thin dark outline, slightly chunky and readable at small sizes.
colour: Draw every item in neutral grayscale only: white, light and dark grays and near-black, with no green, no purple and no tint of any kind, so the game can recolour it. The only colour allowed anywhere on the items is the pistil hairs: thin, short, curly bright orange hairs on the surface. Keep the hairs sparse.
background: The background is one flat, solid, pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, with no gradient, texture, floor, shadow, glow or vignette. Nothing magenta or pink on the items themselves.
layout: Exactly {count} separate items in a loose grid of {grid}, all seen from the same angle (a slight top-down three-quarter view), each centred in its own space, with a wide margin of empty magenta between items and around the picture's edges. Each item is one single connected piece with no loose crumbs, flecks or motion marks beside it. Nothing touches, overlaps or is cut off. No grid lines, no text, no numbers, no labels, no border, no signature.
